text: {"status":"AUTHORIZED_UNIQUE","coverage":[{"text":"先","role":"RELATION","explanation":"Marks the first action in the sequence, fixing 站立5秒 as the initial step."},{"text":"站立","role":"ACTION","explanation":"Requests the stand action; its duration is supplied by the following quantity 5秒."},{"text":"5秒","role":"QUANTITY","explanation":"Supplies stand duration 5 seconds, within the legal positive finite range and below the 60-second stand bound."},{"text":"，","role":"SEPARATOR","explanation":"Separates the first action clause from the next sequential clause; it does not alter action content."},{"text":"然后","role":"RELATION","explanation":"Orders 前进10米 immediately after the stand step."},{"text":"前进","role":"ACTION","explanation":"Requests a walk_forward action; its distance is supplied by 10米."},{"text":"10米","role":"QUANTITY","explanation":"Supplies walk_forward distance 10 meters, positive and finite."},{"text":"，","role":"SEPARATOR","explanation":"Separates the second clause from the next clause without changing authority."},{"text":"再","role":"RELATION","explanation":"Orders 右转30度 after the preceding 前进10米 step; here it means then, not repetition."},{"text":"右转","role":"ACTION","explanation":"Requests a turn to the right; the angle is supplied by 30度."},{"text":"30度","role":"QUANTITY","explanation":"Supplies turn magnitude 30 degrees; right turn maps to -30 degrees, nonzero finite and within the 180-degree bound."},{"text":"，","role":"SEPARATOR","explanation":"Separates the turn clause from the following clause."},{"text":"之后","role":"RELATION","explanation":"Orders 前进4米 after the preceding 右转30度 step."},{"text":"前进","role":"ACTION","explanation":"Requests another walk_forward action, distinct from the earlier 前进10米; its distance is supplied by 4米."},{"text":"4米","role":"QUANTITY","explanation":"Supplies the second walk_forward distance 4 meters, positive and finite."},{"text":"，","role":"SEPARATOR","explanation
